12.title: Taqat Academy
12.description: A multilingual e-learning platform offering courses, seminars, and articles, with complete authentication, course enrollment and purchasing, multi-currency pricing, advanced search and filtering, and fully dynamic content managed through a custom-built admin dashboard.
12.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, i18n, RESTful APIs.
features: Multilingual (i18n) interface with full RTL/LTR support.
Complete authentication flow: login, registration, and forgot/reset password.
Course enrollment and a secure purchase flow for paid courses.
Multi-currency pricing with instant switching between SAR and USD.
Advanced search and filtering across courses, seminars, and articles.
Informational pages: About Us, Contact Us, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Use.
Fully dynamic content powered by a custom admin dashboard I developed.
Smooth animations, image galleries, and a fully responsive design.

13.title: Meetm ERP
13.description: A comprehensive ERP dashboard for managing users and business data, featuring role-based access control, interactive charts and reports, a notification system for targeted or broadcast messaging, and real-time chat monitoring and moderation powered by Pusher.
13.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, MUI, Redux Toolkit, Pusher, RESTful APIs.
features: Secure authentication with roles and permissions (RBAC).
User and data management with full CRUD operations.
Statistics and reports visualized through interactive charts.
Notification center: create and send notifications to all or selected users.
Real-time chat with users powered by Pusher.
Live monitoring of user-to-user conversations with block and suspend controls.
Account settings for updating profile and security information.
Responsive, data-rich UI built with MUI components.

14.title: QuoteHub Dashboard
14.description: An end-to-end marketplace system I built across three dashboards — admin, customer, and provider — where customers post requests, providers submit offers, and both negotiate in real time under full admin supervision, with approvals, reports, support, and complete content management.
14.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Pusher, MUI, Redux Toolkit, RESTful APIs.
features: Three interconnected dashboards (admin, customer, and provider), all built by me.
Full authentication with role-based access for each side of the platform.
Request-to-offer workflow: customers create requests and providers submit offers.
Real-time chat via Pusher across three stages: negotiation, acceptance, and warranty.
Admin monitoring of every conversation, with the ability to suspend or stop it.
Profile update requests from customers and providers require admin approval.
Block and report flows between users, all routed to the admin for review.
Dedicated management for ratings, reports, support tickets, and discount codes.
CMS sections for About, Privacy Policy, Terms, cities, and site settings.
Full CRUD with status control and interactive charts on every module.

15.title: MLA Academy
15.description: An educational platform for browsing and enrolling in courses, built with TypeScript, featuring a complete authentication flow, Stripe-powered checkout, and fully dynamic content managed through a dedicated admin dashboard.
15.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Stripe, Tailwind CSS, RESTful APIs.
features: Course catalog with detailed course pages and enrollment.
Complete authentication: registration, login, and account recovery.
Secure course payments processed end to end with Stripe.
All content is dynamic and controlled from a custom admin dashboard.
Responsive, accessible interface written in TypeScript.

16.title: QuoteHub
16.description: The public marketing site for the QuoteHub platform, presenting the customer and provider dashboards, their features, and subscription plans, with polished animations that guide visitors toward signing up.
16.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
features: Clear presentation of the platform's features and pricing plans.
Dedicated sections describing the customer and provider dashboards.
Subscription flow that onboards users into the platform.
Smooth, modern animations throughout the page.
Fully responsive layout optimized for conversions.

17.title: Bold Website
17.description: A polished company website that introduces the business, showcases its services and pricing, and publishes a blog, designed to attract and convert clients with a modern, animated experience.
17.subDescription: Using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
features: Company profile with a clear presentation of services and pricing.
Blog section for publishing articles and updates.
Client-focused layout built to drive inquiries and engagement.
Smooth animations and a fully responsive design.
